basic_info.description: Sensational opportunity to own a semi-detached turn of the century Victorian home with approved plans to restore it to its former glory on an oversized lot in the vibrant Bayview district of San Francisco! 1552 Palou Avenue has plans to build more than 3,000 square feet of living space with a modern open layout spanning three levels including a grand staircase, a top floor master bedroom suite with breathtaking views, and a large garage with plenty of room for storage. The double sized lot and outdoor space offer the perfect complement for a home of this magnitude, and multiple possibilities on how to utilize this cherished space. Do not miss this chance to build in the dynamic Bayview district of San Francisco located near shops, restaurants, cafes, Chase Center, T-Line, HWY 101/280 and more!
